svg.title: A child with a seizure: ABCDE and a bedside glucose and blood gas for every child, then fever and the seizure's features sort a simple from a complex febrile seizure, and a seizure past 5 minutes is convulsive status epilepticus treated by the clock with benzodiazepines, then a second-line load, then the intensive care unit; causes by age and cause-specific treatment are below
